messages:
Ivy Chen: Hey team — Aquila Systems signed off on a short customer story. They saw ~2.7x throughput uplift and ~27% infra cost savings after moving key services to Redwood Dedicated. Can we scope interviews, legal review, design, and lead routing?

Marco Ruiz: Nice. Who do we have as the contact and what quote commitments?

Ivy Chen: Contact is Noor Alvi (Director of Platform). She agreed to a 20-minute on-record interview and a 2-sentence quote. Also open to a short webinar if timing fits.

Samira Patel: I can run the interview and pull a 60-90s clip for social. Thurs afternoons are best.

Greg Owens: I'll pull perf charts and a small appendix with batch sizes and request mix. ETA Monday morning. Will redact any PII.

Ivy Chen: Messaging priorities: 2.7x throughput, 27% cost savings via smarter batching + KV cache, more predictable tail latency with Dedicated pools. Please avoid naming prior vendors or instance SKUs.

Marco Ruiz: Drafting hero copy and social variants. Want distinct dev and exec headlines. Also thinking of an invite-only webinar for technical leads.

Samira Patel: Suggested interview questions: 1) baseline infra pain, 2) migration steps and timeline, 3) measurable SLO improvements, 4) developer experience changes, 5) one-liner for header.

Ivy Chen: @routing-bot — when we publish, route trial inquiries to trials@redwood.ai and enterprise interest to apac-sales@redwood.ai. Add tag source=case-aquila and region=apac. Also add a form checkbox: "Interested in Dedicated (predictable latency)".

routing-bot: Confirmed. trials -> trials@redwood.ai, enterprise -> apac-sales@redwood.ai. Tagging rules applied. Will map checkbox to SDR playbook.

Greg Owens: Uploaded redacted graphs to the shared Drive and added alt text. Small table for the page:
```
Metric | Before | After
Throughput (req/s) | 95 | 257
P50 latency | 130ms | 48ms
Infra cost | baseline | -27% (batching + cache)
```

Marco Ruiz: Initial quote sent to Noor: "Redwood gave us predictable latency and freed engineers to focus on models, not infra."

Noor Alvi (Aquila Systems): On record: "Redwood helped us reduce operational overhead and scale inference predictably." She prefers the phrase "reduce operational overhead" over "free engineers".

Samira Patel: Scheduling interview — sent calendar invite for Thu 10:30 AM SGT. Will record and drop transcript in Drive.

Ivy Chen: Legal check — sending final quote and redacted screenshots. @legal-bot please review for logo usage and attribution rules.

legal-bot: Please ensure screenshots have no internal IDs or API keys and avoid comparative claims naming competitors. For logo use, submit the signed release or an email thread. Turnaround typically 48-72 hours.

Marco Ruiz: Noor provided logo and a short release email. Uploading now. Also drafting two hero lines for A/B test:
A) "Aquila Systems increased throughput 2.7x with Redwood Dedicated."
B) "Predictable low-latency at scale: Aquila Systemss migration to Dedicated."

Samira Patel: I like B for the public page, A is good for technical channels.

Greg Owens: Also added a brief tech appendix with batch sizes, typical sequence lengths, and KV cache hit rate (no PII). Will link from case page for devs.

legal-bot: Received assets and quote. Requesting minor redaction of one screenshot that included an internal dashboard label. Please submit a redacted version. Approval pending.

Ivy Chen: Will replace the screenshot and re-upload. Ops-bot please add campaign tag: campaign=aquila-q1 and schedule publish window.

ops-bot: Campaign tag added: campaign=aquila-q1, publish_window=2025-06-02_to_2025-06-09, assets=case_study,webinar. UTM parameters queued.

Marco Ruiz: Draft landing copy and social snippets added to Drive. Also proposing a gated technical appendix to capture higher-intent leads (email + role required).

routing-bot: Gated appendix mapped to apac-sales@redwood.ai. Add tag intent=gated_appendix.

Samira Patel: Noor approved the revised quote: "Redwood helped us reduce operational overhead and scale inference predictably." Also ok with a slightly longer technical quote for the body.

Noor Alvi (Aquila Systems): Technical quote: "By moving critical services to Redwood Dedicated and tuning batching policies, we saw a measurable increase in throughput and lower costs without compromising tail latency." On-record and approved.

legal-bot: Final review complete. Approval code LEG-2025-477. You may publish once the redacted screenshot is in the Drive and copy is finalized.

Ivy Chen: Timeline proposal:
- Mon 2025-05-26: final assets in Drive
- Wed 2025-05-28: design QA + legal clearance confirmed
- Tue 2025-06-03: publish case study & social drip (dev + exec channels)
- Thu 2025-06-05: webinar with Noor (technical 30-40 min + 10 min Q&A)

Marco Ruiz: Preparing webinar promo and the A/B hero variants for testing. Will schedule social cadence.

routing-bot: Lead routing rules and webhooks applied: /webhooks/marketing/lead-router.

Ivy Chen: Thanks everyone. Once live, paste the URL here and I'll close the thread. :sparkles:

ops-bot: Publishing scheduled. Live URL (once published) will be https://redwood.ai/case/aquila-systems. Closing thread after publish. :tada:
